import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C;
    static int r, c;
    static long total;
    static long min_diff_val = (long)1e18, min_z_val = -1;
    static long[][] memo_map5;
    static String s;
    static int[] cntA, cntB;

    static void search_state(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (min_diff_val <= 1 || diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= min_diff_val) {
            return;
        }
        if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
            long diff_now = Math.abs(x - y);
            if (diff_now < min_diff_val) {
                min_diff_val = diff_now;
                min_z_val = x;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= r) {
            long inc1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            search_state(x, y + inc1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= r) {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long inc2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            search_state(x + sum1 * inc2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    static long recurse4(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long state_id = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        if (memo_map5[(int)state_id][0] != -1) {
            return memo_map5[(int)state_id][0];
        }
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        long res = 0;
        if (diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > min_diff_val) {
            memo_map5[(int)state_id][0] = 0;
            return 0;
        }
        if (v1 < r || v2 < r) {
            int sum = v1 + v2;
            if (v1 >= cntA[sum] && v2 >= cntB[sum]) {
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                res = C[v1][r] >= 0 && v1 >= 0 && v2 >= 0 ? C[v1][r] : 0;
                memo_map5[(int)state_id][0] = res;
                return res;
            }
            memo_map5[(int)state_id][0] = 0;
            return 0;
        }
        long res_acc = 0;
        char ch_char = s.charAt(v1 + v2 - 1);
        if (ch_char != 'B') {
            long delta1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            res_acc += recurse4(x, y + delta1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (ch_char != 'A') {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long delta2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            res_acc += recurse4(x + sum1 * delta2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        memo_map5[(int)state_id][0] = res_acc;
        return res_acc;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int size = 2 * (r + c) + 1;
        C = new long[size][size];

        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (r + c); j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }

        total = C[r + c][r] * C[r + c][r];

        long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
        while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
            if (x > y) {
                long delta1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
                long sum2 = C[v2][r];
                y += delta1 * sum2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long sum1 = C[v1][r];
                long delta2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
                x += sum1 * delta2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        min_diff_val = Math.abs(x - y);

        search_state(0, 0, r + c, r + c);

        s = br.readLine();
        int length = s.length();
        cntA = new int[length + 1];
        cntB = new int[length + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (s.charAt(i) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (s.charAt(i) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        // Initialize memoization array
        int memoSize = (int)(x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2) + 1;
        memo_map5 = new long[memoSize][1];
        for (long[] row : memo_map5) {
            row[0] = -1;
        }

        long answer5 = recurse4(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        System.out.println(answer5);
    }
}
